contentHtml:
Assam: A husband-wife duo working as drug inspectors in Assam has been dismissed from government service following separate corruption-related cases involving bribery and alleged possession of disproportionate assets.

Tejendra Saikia, who was serving as a drug inspector in Jorhat, was arrested by the Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption in 2024 while allegedly accepting a bribe of ₹4,000.

In a separate case, his wife Jahnavi Kalita, who was posted as a drug inspector in Sivasagar, faced proceedings over allegations of possessing assets disproportionate to her known sources of income.

According to a recent media report in the India TodayNE, the two officials were arrested by the vigilance authorities in separate corruption-related cases. Following the subsequent proceedings, the Assam government took disciplinary action against both and dismissed them from government service.
